full_page.content:
1947, February 5
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.J. Cap.
February 5th, 1947
Mr. and Mrs. Joseph J. O'Donnell. 1120 Lake Shore Drive. Chicago, Illinois.
Blessed be God in His angels and in His saints! Feb. 5th - 10:30 pm - Before postponements How wonderful is the Lord in all His ways! How can we ever appreciate - be gratiful !!! I enjoyed your letter ....
St. Felix Friary Route 8 Huntington, Indiana
Not that this or that person was directly concerned, but it would be a happy theme if one had time a ability to go into details of such a privilege and such a manifestation of God's mercy and generous condescention to any - to us - poor sinners. Thanks be to God for all His hidden designs - as well as for those we praise as manifestations.
Fr. Guardian just came across the corridor (almost expected a reminder to retire) to tell me we would have the High Mass on Friday for you and your intentions - the first of five for your Int. - besides Enrollments. Praised be Jesus! ... Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
